content:
ajohnson: Quick heads-up: found ~9% token overcount in vendor metering for several promo-tier customers this billing window — vendor export totals > our ledger. Suspect replay/ratecap apportionment duplication.

maria-ops: can you paste a couple redacted examples from the vendor CSV?

ajohnson: vendor rows (redacted):
```
customer_id,window_start,ingest_tokens,ratecap_apportioned
ACME-123,2026-02-01T00:00Z,120000,132000
PLAT-42,2026-02-01T00:00Z,80000,88000
```

liam: are those exports from dedupe-v3 or the legacy nightly export?

ajohnson: vendor claims dedupe-v3. Our internal ledger shows the lower counts. Opening vendor ticket.

maria-ops: @finance-bot run: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.tokens WHERE window_start='2026-02-01' AND invoice_tag='promo-2026-02'` and pull vendor_total from S3 export for same window.

finance-bot: Query queued; will post results here.

sara: invoice run next Tue — do we hold invoices for impacted tenants?

liam: hold until root cause confirmed. If internal bug, we absorb; if vendor bug, request credit.

finance-bot: Done. totals: internal=1200000, vendor=1320000. Top deltas: ACME-123:+12000, PLAT-42:+8000, BETA-7:+6000. Most delta rows flagged with headers `x-proxy-replay: true` and `x-replay-origin: proxy`.

sara: contract Clause 4.2 says "Replay events for delivery guarantees shall not be billable to the customer." We should reference that in vendor ticket.

ajohnson: vendor ticket #VND-4521 created; attached sample rows + contract clause + event ids: [evt_abc123, evt_def456, evt_ghi789]. Vendor replied they
re investigating (48h SLA).

maria-ops: action items: 1) ajohnson: vendor ticket + samples; 2) sara: hold invoices under $5k for affected tenants; 3) liam: audit ratecap_apportioner for double-count on retries and add telemetry/dedupe.

sara: approved: auto-hold invoices <=$5k for now. I'll prepare a credit memo template for quick issuance. Pre-approve credits <= $2k for promo customers; >$2k needs manager sign-off.

liam: quick grep: `billing/allocators/ratecap_apportioner.go` contains a TODO around retries. I'll add a short fix + telemetry and a one-off tracer to correlate replay_id from edge to billing events. ETA EOD.

maria-ops: also confirm whether edge proxy sets `x-proxy-replay` consistently and whether that flows to the vendor export. @liam please add temporary header trace.

ajohnson: will update when vendor responds. If vendor concedes error, we need retro credits and approval flow. Sara: noted your thresholds, will queue credit requests as needed. :thumbsup:
